summary: Round 1 fixes in commit a9dcd99 cleanly resolve all three majors and all three minors. The layout block (lines 23-26) no longer references MCP_SERVER_BACKEND_FEATURES_COMPARISON.md; the validation table no longer carries that file as a row; and 'Next steps' item 2 was rewritten to drop docs/historical/ and add docs/problems/ in its place — consistent with tech-spec Decision 2 and the user-spec criterion that docs/historical/ is not created. The DRAG_ANALYSIS and WEB_RESEARCH rows were reworded from past-tense 'Edited: ...' to forward-looking 'Restored verbatim. Pending: ... (Wave 3, Task 4).' which matches the actual Task-1 state (verified verbatim against upstream 7a68a973 in round 1). The five problems/* and PDF rows now read 'Ready to promote to docs/problems/...' and 'Ready to promote to docs/research/...' instead of false past-tense 'Promoted to docs/...' claims. Internal consistency is preserved: the layout, validation table, dropped-files section, and next-steps block all agree on the same set of recovered files (no MCP_SERVER..., no CRITICAL_REVIEW.md) and the same forward direction (docs/usecases, docs/competitive-landscape, docs/research, docs/problems; no docs/historical). Filesystem matches: recovered/competitive-landscape/ contains exactly the three .md files the layout names plus README.md. The fix introduces no new content beyond the targeted reword/removal — no new findings, no regressions. The round-1 nit about appending a 'Promoted on YYYY-MM-DD in commit <hash>' line was non-blocking and intentionally deferred to Task 15 / post-Wave-3, which remains correct. Approving.
